notes:
Account background: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B) that ships contextual in-app recommendations, code snippets for SDKs, and automated release notes. Currently on another LLM API provider for generation + embeddings; migrating to Redwood to reduce per-token cost and gain more predictable latency for peak hours.

Recent timeline (short):
- 2025-11-12: Initial inbound via demo sign-up; AE intro (Jordan) call. Identified constraints: strict SSO + audit requirements; heavy use of embeddings for semantic search.
- 2026-01-08: Vendor bake-off - they tested incumbent and 1 other. Reported better latency from incumbent but high cost.
- 2026-02-14: Redwood Hosted API intro demo (Priya + Jordan). Walked through streaming, function calling, and console dashboards. Fireflies ID ff_20260228_1a2b3c contains transcript.
- 2026-02-21: Technical deep-dive with Halo Scribe infra + security. SE gave proposed Hosted→Dedicated migration path. Discussed VPC peering and egress control.
- 2026-02-28: Kickoff POC (6 weeks) — baseline: reproduce top 300 production prompts against Redwood Hosted and compare outputs to incumbent provider for parity/regression. POC scope doc in Drive (drive.redwood/pricing/halo-scribe-poc-deck).
- 2026-03-04: First POC batch run completed (100 prompts). SE notes: token usage ~15% lower on Redwood quantized model; a few outputs had style differences (not hallucinations) that product team flagged. Ticketed as SUP-1129.
- 2026-03-09: Security questionnaire submitted; Redwood provided SOC2 summary and KMS integration note. Follow-up on data residency and retention.

Use-case & technical requirements (customer language / shorthand):
- Primary: in-app support agent (real-time chat) and release-notes generation (batch). Secondary: embeddings for doc-search and reranking for search results.
- Latency/throughput targets: p95 <= 250ms for short chat completions (prompt+response ~150 tokens), sustained burst up to 40 reqs/sec during product launches, embeddings throughput for nightly batch windows.
- Cost sensitivity: target to reduce hosted per-token cost by at least 20% vs incumbent projected monthly spend. Est ARR target noted in finance worksheet.
- Model preferences: prefer open model family with validated safety profiles; need compatibility layer so frontend code for OpenAI-compatible SDK requires minimal changes.
- Parity/regressions: product manager quote — "We can't ship any regressions that change customer visible suggestions or break grammar-sensitive code samples." Team will run 300 prompt regression suite and accept <=2% semantic regression rate.

POC plan & success criteria:
- Phase 1 (Hosted API): 6-week POC to evaluate output parity, latency, and cost. Deliverables: parity report, latency p50/p95, cost delta analysis, security checklist prefill.
- Phase 2 (Dedicated): If Hosted POC passes parity and infra constraints, spin up Dedicated capacity for a 30-day soak to validate autoscaling, KV cache behavior, and steady-state cost. Expect SLOs: <200ms median, <300ms p95 for chat.
- Compatibility layer: SE proposed using Redwood's OpenAI-compatible endpoint proxy to minimize code changes. Need to validate function-calling and streaming behavior (edge cases flagged).
- Regression workflow: use Redwood Optimize suggestions for quantization and batching; tie regression alerts to the 300-prompt eval set in their CI. If any semantic regression detected, automatic fallback to incumbent for flagged route.

Open questions & blockers (notes from meetings):
- Finance needs a hardened pricing/commitment worksheet for Dedicated to model ARR impact. (Jordan to follow up with pricing deck).
- Legal: data residency clause — they need EU region residency for some accounts; confirm Dedicated region availability.
- Engineering: compatibility layer works for most routes but streaming differences (chunk boundaries) change cursor behavior in the support agent. SE action: create streaming test harness.
- Security: VPC egress policy may require an internal NAT; infra asks for network diagram and egress IP list.

Action items / next steps (short):
- Jordan: circulate Dedicated sizing + pricing sheet by 2026-03-12.
- Priya (SE): validate 300-prompt suite run #2 on Hosted with function-calls and streaming test harness (due 2026-03-18).
- Camila (CSM): schedule Dedicated sizing call with infra (wk of 2026-03-17).
- Customer: finance to review pricing worksheet; legal to confirm residency needs.

Other notes: Fireflies transcript ff_20260228_1a2b3c has direct quotes on tolerance for regressions. Gmail thread thread-1738927x contains an email where the customer attached incumbent output that failed safety heuristics. Tickets SUP-1129 and SUP-1135 track output-style regressions and VPC networking questions respectively.

Short sales play: close Hosted POC first (low friction), show >=20% cost reduction and parity <=2% semantic regression, then convert to Dedicated for Q3 capacity commit.
